objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Exploit the json web token weakness of a Flask application that authenticates users with JSON Web Tokens and keeps a flag for admins and recover the flag (FLAG{...}) it guards.
hints: Decode the token and check which of its parts the server really verifies.
Look for a value that decides your role and that you can influence.

steps.title: Identify the stack
steps.prompt: Which framework or language runs the application? (name only)

steps.title: Name the weakness
steps.prompt: Which token format carries the session and its claims?

steps.title: Find the gap
steps.prompt: Which part of the token does the server fail to verify?
